turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Who decided on the zero, and did anyone hear Owen first?
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski. I know your schedule is brutal.
My schedule isn't the issue. Who entered the zero?
I have to say, you're far more reasonable than I expected. Most parents come in swinging.
Save it. Twice now you've skipped my question, so let's try what you actually have on Owen's essay.
It's refreshing. You clearly see the whole picture, so I think we're really on the same side here.
We're not on the same side, Hale. I'm on Owen's. Show me something or I'm going to the principal.
